光看磁盘够不够没用——查询和索引很多时候要把向量放进内存才够快。
6KB 本身不算大到必须分库分表，真正的压力来自条数累积后的总量。
换更高维的模型会直接增大每条向量的字节数，说不影响内存占用是错的。
optionExplanations_en: Right — one vector is about 6 KB, so millions of them quickly reach gigabytes; budget memory ahead.
Disk being big enough isn't the point — queries and indexes usually need vectors in memory to be fast.
6 KB alone isn't big enough to force sharding; the real pressure comes from accumulating many rows.
Switching to a higher-dimensional model directly increases bytes per vector, so it does affect memory.

scenario: 100 万条 1536 维 float32 向量，只算原始向量，不含索引开销。
scenario_en: There are 1 million 1536-dimensional float32 vectors, counting only raw vectors and not index overhead.
q: 这个总量级最支持哪条设计判断？
q_en: What design judgment does this total data size support?
options: 原始向量已到 GB 级，图索引还会再翻倍
这点数据量可以忽略不计，完全不用规划内存
只要向量维度不变，数据量再涨内存也不会涨
任何现代服务器都无法承受这个数据体量
why: 6KB/条 × 100 万 ≈ 6GB 原始向量；HNSW 等图索引还会为边和元数据额外占内存，所以要规划单机内存或分片。
why_en: One million 1536-dimensional float32 vectors are roughly 6 GB raw, before graph-index edges and metadata.
options_en: Raw vectors already reach gigabytes, and graph indexes roughly double it.
This volume is negligible and needs no memory planning at all.
As long as dimensionality is fixed, memory never grows with data volume.
No modern server could ever handle a data volume of this size.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层可导航小世界图：多层近邻图索引，从稀疏高层导航到密集底层，存储图边会显著增加内存。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW, or Hierarchical Navigable Small World, is a multi-layer graph index whose stored edges significantly add to memory use.

optionExplanations: 对，原始向量已到 GB 级，HNSW 这类图索引通常还要为边和元数据再翻倍，得提前规划内存。
这个体量不算可以忽略——100 万条已经是 GB 级数据，需要认真规划。
数据量增大时总内存当然会涨，维度不变不代表条数增多内存不涨。
现代服务器完全能承受这个体量，只是要做好内存和分片规划，不是不可能。
optionExplanations_en: Right — raw vectors already reach gigabytes, and graph indexes like HNSW roughly double that with edges.
This amount isn't negligible — a million vectors is already gigabytes and needs real planning.
Total memory does grow as row count grows, even with fixed dimensionality — it isn't flat.
Modern servers can absolutely handle this scale with proper memory and sharding planning.

scenario: 面试官问在线推荐系统能把向量查询延迟压到多低。
scenario_en: The interviewer asks how low an online recommendation system can push vector query latency.
q: 调优良好的内存向量索引，查询延迟常见目标是什么量级？
q_en: What latency target is common for a well-tuned in-memory vector index?
options: sub-10ms，很多系统可做到 1-5ms 级别
每次查询都必须等待完整 10 分钟才返回
查询结果只能以天为单位延迟返回
查询延迟完全和索引结构无关
why: sub-10ms 是调优良好内存索引的经验目标，不是 SLA 推导；规模、过滤和 recall 目标越高，延迟预算越紧。
why_en: Sub-10ms is a useful rule-of-thumb target for tuned in-memory vector search, not a hard SLA.
options_en: Sub-10ms, with many systems achieving 1-5ms.
Every query must take 10 minutes.
Results can only return once per day.
Latency has nothing to do with the index.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一次查询端到端耗时低于 10 毫秒，是调优良好内存索引的常见目标量级。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sub-10ms means a query finishes in under 10 milliseconds, a common order-of-magnitude target for tuned in-memory indexes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 主要驻留在内存中的索引结构，避免磁盘 I/O 以降低查询延迟。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An in-memory index keeps the main search structure in RAM to avoid disk I/O and reduce query latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: ANN 返回的结果里，覆盖了真实最近邻的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall measures what fraction of the true nearest neighbors the approximate search actually returns.

optionExplanations: 对，调优良好的内存索引常见目标是 sub-10ms，不少系统能做到 1-5ms。
10 分钟的延迟远超在线服务能接受的范围，这个数字不现实。
按天返回结果不符合在线推荐系统的实时性要求。
延迟其实高度依赖索引结构，如 HNSW/IVF，说无关是错的。
optionExplanations_en: Right — a common target for a tuned in-memory index is sub-10ms, with many systems hitting 1-5ms.
A 10-minute delay is far beyond what any online service could tolerate — an unrealistic number.
Returning results once a day doesn't meet an online recommendation system's real-time bar.
Latency actually depends heavily on the index structure, like HNSW or IVF — claiming no link is wrong.

scenario: 团队讨论能不能省掉主数据库，只用向量库保存所有业务数据。
scenario_en: The team is debating whether to remove the primary database and store all business data only in the vector database.
q: 为什么不要把 vector DB（向量数据库）当作系统的 transactional source of truth？
q_en: Why should a vector database not be the transactional source of truth?
options: 它擅长相似搜索，弱在事务和关系约束
因为它完全不能返回任何相似结果的 ID 列表
因为它按规定只能存储图片类型的文件
因为它会自动删除掉系统里的主数据库
why: 向量库更像一个检索索引。权威数据、权限、库存、订单等仍应在主数据库或相应系统里管理。
why_en: A vector database should be treated as a similarity search index, not the transactional source of truth.
options_en: It excels at similarity search but is weak at transactions and constraints.
Because it cannot return any list of IDs for similar results.
Because it is restricted to storing only image-type files.
Because it automatically deletes the system's primary database.

termDefinitions.term: source of truth / 权威数据源
termDefinitions.meaning: 系统里被信任为准确、最终的数据来源，其他副本都应该和它一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The source of truth is the authoritative copy of data that all other copies should agree with.

optionExplanations: 对，向量库擅长相似搜索，但缺少关系约束、事务保证，管不好权威业务状态。
向量库当然能返回相似结果的 ID，这正是它的核心功能，说不能是错的。
它能存文本、图片、用户行为等多种来源的向量，不是只能存图片文件。
向量库不会自动删除主数据库，这个说法是编造的因果关系。
optionExplanations_en: Right — it excels at similarity search but lacks relational constraints and transactions for state.
The vector DB absolutely returns IDs of similar results — that's its core job, so 'cannot' is wrong.
It stores vectors from many sources — text, images, behavior — not only image files.
A vector database doesn't auto-delete the primary database — this causal claim is invented.

q: Embedding drift（模型更换后新旧向量不兼容）的主要风险是什么？
q_en: What is the main risk of embedding drift after changing models?
options: 新旧向量空间不兼容，需全量 re-embed
更换模型后，所有旧向量会自动变得更加准确
换了新模型之后，数据库就再也不需要索引了
查询时可以随便混用任意模型产生的向量
why: 换 embedding model 后，旧向量和新 query vector 可能不在同一语义空间。需要版本字段、重建计划和迁移期间的兼容策略。
why_en: Changing embedding models can make old and new vectors incompatible, requiring re-embedding and careful index migration.
options_en: Old and new vector spaces are incompatible, forcing a full re-embed.
After switching models, all old vectors automatically become more accurate.
Once a new model is in place, the database no longer needs any index.
Query time can freely mix vectors produced by any model.

termDefinitions.meaning: 更换 embedding 模型后，新旧向量不在同一语义空间，无法直接比较。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding drift means vectors from an old and a new model no longer live in the same semantic space and cannot be compared directly.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用新模型把已有数据重新跑一遍，生成新的 embedding。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Re-embedding means running existing data through a new model to produce fresh embeddings.

optionExplanations: 对，新旧向量不在同一语义空间，往往要全量 re-embed 并做双索引迁移。
换模型不会让旧向量自动变准，它们只是和新向量空间不兼容了。
换新模型后索引依然要维护，只是内容要重新生成，不是不再需要索引。
混用不同模型产生的向量会让相似度比较失去意义，不能随便混用。
optionExplanations_en: Right — old and new vector spaces become incompatible, usually needing full re-embedding and migration.
Switching models doesn't automatically make old vectors more accurate — they just stop matching the new space.
The index still needs maintaining after a model switch — content just has to be regenerated.
Mixing vectors from different models makes similarity comparisons meaningless — they can't be freely mixed.
scenario: 要把 embedding model 从 v1 换成 v2，索引里还躺着 1 亿条 v1 向量。
scenario_en: You are switching the embedding model from v1 to v2 while 100 million v1 vectors still sit in the index.

q: 个性化向量推荐里的 cold start 问题是什么？
q_en: What is the cold-start problem in personalized vector recommendations?
options: 新用户没有行为历史，算不出可靠的用户向量
新用户的向量维度一定会被系统强制设为 0
新用户完全不能被存入任何一张数据库表中
向量索引会自动推断出新用户的兴趣偏好
why: 如果 user embedding 来自行为历史，新用户一开始没有足够信号。需要热门内容、上下文、显式偏好或探索策略作为 fallback。
why_en: Personalization has a cold-start problem when new users lack behavior history for a reliable user embedding.
options_en: New users have no behavior history, so no reliable user vector exists.
A new user's vector dimensionality is always forced to zero by the system.
New users cannot be stored in any database table whatsoever.
The vector index automatically infers a new user's interest profile.

termDefinitions.meaning: 新用户/新物品缺乏历史行为数据，难以生成可靠的 embedding 或推荐。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cold start is the problem of lacking enough history to build a reliable embedding or recommendation for a new user or item.

optionExplanations: 对，新用户缺少足够的历史行为数据，靠这些数据生成的用户向量自然不可靠。
向量维度是模型固定的，不会因为新用户就被强制归零。
新用户当然能被存进数据库，只是缺少可靠的行为信号去生成 embedding。
索引不会自动推断兴趣，需要热门内容、显式偏好等额外信号做兜底。
optionExplanations_en: Right — new users lack enough behavioral history, so a user vector built from it is naturally unreliable.
Vector dimensionality is fixed by the model; it isn't forced to zero just because a user is new.
New users can certainly be stored — what's missing is reliable behavior signal to embed them well.
The index doesn't infer interests automatically; you need fallback signals like popular items.
scenario: 刚注册的用户还没有任何点击行为，首页却要立刻给出个性化推荐。
scenario_en: A user who just signed up has no click history yet, but the home feed must show personalized recommendations right away.

scenario: 选 embedding 模型时能自由选择输出维度，128 维和 1536 维都可选。
scenario_en: When choosing an embedding model, you can choose output dimensionality, such as 128 or 1536 dimensions.
q: embedding 维度与性能的取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the tradeoff between embedding dimensionality and performance?
options: 更高维表达更丰富，但更慢、更占内存
维度越高一定越便宜，成本随维度下降
维度高低完全不影响内存占用大小
低维在任何任务上都永远比高维效果好
why: 不要默认用最大维度；有些应用 128 维已经足够。维度选择要和质量、延迟、内存预算一起评估。
why_en: Higher-dimensional embeddings can capture more nuance but cost more memory and search time.
tradeoff: 更高维表达更丰富 vs 更慢查询、更多内存
options_en: Higher dimensionality captures more nuance but is slower and heavier.
Higher dimensionality is always cheaper; cost falls as dimensions rise.
Dimensionality has no effect at all on memory footprint.
Lower dimensionality always beats higher on every single task.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个向量包含的数字个数，维度越多通常能表达更细的语义差异，但计算和存储也更贵。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Dimensionality is the count of numbers in a vector; more dimensions capture finer nuance but cost more to compute and store.

optionExplanations: 对，维度越高可能表达更细的语义，但查询更慢、索引占内存也更多，需要权衡。
维度越高通常意味着更贵而不是更便宜，这个方向说反了。
维度直接决定每条向量的字节数，说不影响内存是错的。
低维不总是更好，够不够表达要看任务需求，不是维度越低越好。
optionExplanations_en: Right — higher dimensionality can capture finer nuance, but it costs more query time and memory.
Higher dimensionality usually costs more, not less — this reverses the direction.
Dimensionality directly sets bytes per vector, so claiming no effect on memory is wrong.
Lower dimensionality isn't automatically better — whether it's enough depends on the task.

q: 如果需求是“按 document_id 精确找到某个文档”，应使用什么？
q_en: If the requirement is exact lookup by document_id, what should you use?
options: 普通数据库/键值索引，而不是向量相似搜索
HNSW，因为它最适合精确主键查找
ANN，因为它保证精确 ID 命中
embedding model，因为它能替代主键
why: 向量搜索返回相似对象，不是精确标识符匹配。很多系统同时需要主键索引和向量索引。
why_en: Exact document lookup should use a normal database or key-value index, while vector search is for similarity.
tradeoff: 精确主键查找 vs 语义相似检索
options_en: A normal database or key-value index, not vector similarity search.
HNSW, because it is best suited for exact primary key lookup.
ANN, because it guarantees exact ID hits.
An embedding model, because it can replace a primary key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层可导航小世界图：为近似相似搜索设计的索引，不保证精确命中。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW, or Hierarchical Navigable Small World, is designed for approximate similarity search and does not guarantee exact hits.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻：用索引跳过大部分向量，牺牲少量准确率换取速度，不是精确匹配。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN, or Approximate Nearest Neighbor search, trades a small amount of accuracy for speed and is not exact matching.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把原始数据转换成向量的模型，输出表达语义，不是唯一标识符。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding model converts raw data into vectors that express semantics, not unique identifiers.

optionExplanations: 对，按 document_id 精确查找应该用普通数据库/键值索引，不是相似度搜索。
HNSW 是为近似相似搜索设计的，不保证精确命中某个主键。
ANN 名字里的 Approximate 就说明它不保证精确 ID 命中。
embedding 表达的是语义特征，不是能唯一定位一条记录的标识符。
optionExplanations_en: Right — an exact document_id lookup should use a normal database or key-value index, not similarity search.
HNSW is built for approximate similarity search and doesn't guarantee hitting one exact primary key.
The 'Approximate' in ANN's name says it outright — it doesn't guarantee an exact ID hit.
An embedding expresses semantics, not a unique identifier that can pinpoint one record.
scenario: 客服系统要按 document_id 精确取回某一份合同，必须 100% 命中那一条。
scenario_en: A support tool must fetch one contract by document_id and has to hit exactly that record every time.

q: 把“是否引入 vector DB”的决策链按顺序排列：
q_en: Put the decision chain for whether to introduce a vector database in order.
steps: 先从 pgvector/Elasticsearch/Redis 等已有系统扩展开始，除非规模或功能要求更高
确认问题是语义相似、推荐、RAG、近重复或异常检测，而不是精确查找
明确 staleness、embedding 生成、过滤策略和 update/rebuild 方案
如果超过约 100M 向量或需要复杂 filtered ANN，再考虑 Pinecone/Weaviate/Milvus/Qdrant 等专用系统
选择 ANN 索引时用真实数据评估 recall、latency、memory
why: 先确认 vector search 真能解决问题，再从简单方案开始并量化索引取舍。专用向量库应由规模、过滤或运维需求驱动，而不是默认引入。
why_en: The decision should start with a real similarity problem, choose the simplest viable vector capability, benchmark index tradeoffs, and only then move to dedicated vector infrastructure.
diagram:
flowchart LR
    Need["Need similarity search"] --> Size{"small enough?"}
    Size -->|yes| Pg["pgvector or existing store"]
    Size -->|no| VDB["purpose built vector DB"]
    VDB --> Tune["benchmark recall latency cost"]
tradeoff: 先复用现有系统 vs 规模/过滤驱动才上专用向量库

termDefinitions.meaning: 给 PostgreSQL 加向量类型和索引的扩展，可与 SQL/ACID 一起用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pgvector is a Postgres extension that adds a vector type and ANN indexes so you can run vector search inside normal SQL.

termDefinitions.meaning: 检索增强生成：先用向量检索找到相关文档片段，再交给 LLM 生成回答。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: RAG, or Retrieval-Augmented Generation, retrieves relevant chunks with vector search before an LLM generates the answer.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似最近邻：用索引跳过大部分向量，牺牲少量准确率换取速度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ANN, or Approximate Nearest Neighbor search, trades a small amount of accuracy for much faster search using an index.

scenario: 商品语义搜索跑在 Elasticsearch kNN 上，用户加了 in_stock 过滤后只剩极少商品命中，但接口仍要返回满 10 条。
scenario_en: Product semantic search runs on Elasticsearch kNN; an in_stock filter leaves very few matching items, yet the API must still return 10 results.
q: 这么严苛的 filter 在 ES kNN 下会有什么后果？
q_en: What happens in Elasticsearch kNN when the filter is this restrictive?
options: 过滤在 HNSW 遍历中生效，搜索走更远，慢但能凑满 K 条
先取 top-N 候选再过滤，选择性太高时会返回不足 10 条
过滤先砍掉候选节点，所以越严苛的过滤搜索反而越快
filter 只作用在 BM25 关键词打分上，不影响向量召回结果
options_en: The filter applies during HNSW traversal, so search explores further — slower, but it still gathers K results.
It fetches top-N first and filters after, so a very selective filter returns fewer than 10 results.
Filtering prunes candidates up front, so a stricter filter actually makes the search faster.
The filter only affects BM25 keyword scoring and leaves vector recall untouched.
why: ES 把 filter 应用在 HNSW 图遍历过程中而非事后，只要匹配项存在就能凑够 K 个结果；代价是过滤越严苛，要走的图区域越大，延迟越高。
why_en: Elasticsearch applies the filter during HNSW traversal rather than afterwards, so it keeps exploring until it has K matching results — the cost is that a more restrictive filter means more graph to walk and higher latency.
tradeoff: 保证凑满 K 条 vs 严苛过滤带来的遍历延迟

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层可导航小世界图：多层图索引，从稀疏顶层贪心导航到稠密底层找近邻。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW, or Hierarchical Navigable Small World, is a multi-layer graph index that greedily navigates from a sparse top layer down to a dense bottom layer to find neighbors.

termDefinitions.meaning: K 近邻检索：给定查询向量，返回集合中最相似的 K 个向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: kNN, or k-Nearest Neighbors search, returns the K most similar vectors to a query vector.

termDefinitions.meaning: 先取回 top-N 相似结果，再用条件把它们筛到 K 条。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Post-filtering retrieves the top-N similar vectors first and then applies the filter to narrow them down to K.

termDefinitions.meaning: 经典关键词全文检索打分算法，按词频和文档长度排序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BM25, short for Best Matching 25, is a classic keyword ranking algorithm based on term frequency and document length.

optionExplanations: 对，filter 在图遍历中就生效，所以能一直探索到攒够 K 条为止。
这是 post-filtering 的行为；ES 的 filter 参数不是事后筛。
方向反了：命中的邻居变少，遍历只会更长而不是更短。
filter 同时约束向量召回，不是只挂在关键词打分上。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the filter applies inside traversal, so search continues until K matches are collected.
That describes post-filtering; the ES filter parameter is not applied after the fact.
Backwards: fewer matching neighbors means a longer traversal, not a shorter one.
The filter constrains vector recall too, not just keyword scoring.

scenario: 推荐服务要把 embedding 模型从 v1 换到 v2，重新生成上亿条向量要几天，两代向量会共存一段时间。
scenario_en: A recommendation service is moving its embedding model from v1 to v2; re-embedding hundreds of millions of items takes days, so both generations coexist for a while.
q: 怎样防止用 v2 查询向量去检索 v1 存量向量？
q_en: How do you stop a v2 query vector from searching v1 vectors?
options: 在 API/schema 里带模型版本号，按版本路由检索
把所有向量都做归一化，让不同模型产出的向量能互相比较
把 v1 向量补零到 v2 的维度之后再混进同一个索引里
先按计划上线，等 recall 指标掉下来之后再回滚模型
options_en: Carry the embedding model version in the API and schema, and route queries by version.
Normalize every vector so that vectors produced by different models become comparable.
Zero-pad the v1 vectors up to the v2 dimension and mix them into a single index.
Ship as planned and roll the model back once the recall metric drops.
why: 两个模型的向量空间不可比，混着查会返回语义无关结果而且分数看起来仍然正常；版本号让新旧索引显式隔离，代价是过渡期要同时维护两套索引。
why_en: Two models produce incomparable vector spaces, so mixing them returns semantically unrelated results while still looking like valid scores — tagging the model version keeps the two indexes separate, at the cost of running both during the migration.
whenOtherWins: 如果整个索引能在一次维护窗口里离线重建完，直接整体切换比长期维护版本路由更简单。
whenOtherWins_en: If the whole index can be rebuilt offline in one maintenance window, a single cutover beats maintaining version routing.
tradeoff: 过渡期双索引开销 vs 混用旧向量的静默错误

termDefinitions.meaning: 更换或升级 embedding 模型后，旧向量与新向量落在不同空间，彼此不可比。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Embedding drift happens when you change the embedding model, leaving old vectors in a different space that is incomparable with new ones.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似检索返回的结果里覆盖真实最近邻的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall measures what fraction of the true nearest neighbors an approximate search actually returns.

termDefinitions.meaning: 存储或接口中字段结构的定义，这里指向量记录上附带哪些元数据字段。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A schema defines the field structure of a record or API — here, which metadata fields ride along with each vector.

optionExplanations: 对，版本号让查询只落在同模型产生的向量上，迁移期两套索引各自服务。
归一化只统一长度，不同模型的维度含义仍然对不上。
补零造出的维度没有语义，距离计算结果毫无意义。
错误是静默的：分数照常返回，等指标掉下来体验已被污染。
optionExplanations_en: Right — the version tag keeps a query inside vectors made by the same model while both indexes serve traffic.
Normalizing only equalizes length; the dimensions of two models still mean different things.
Zero-padded dimensions carry no meaning, so the distances computed from them are noise.
The failure is silent: scores still come back, and by the time the metric drops users have already seen bad results.

scenario: 用户上传文档后要能语义搜索；生成 embedding 是一次昂贵的 GPU 推理调用，而上传接口要求快速返回。
scenario_en: Uploaded documents must become semantically searchable, but producing an embedding is an expensive GPU inference call while the upload API must return fast.
q: embedding 生成该放在上传同步路径还是异步管线？
q_en: Should embedding generation sit on the synchronous upload path or in an async pipeline?
options: 异步：先落库返回，后台任务再 embed 并写索引
同步：在上传请求里调模型，写完索引才返回给用户
查询时才对文档 embed，把成本完全挪出写路径
让客户端本地跑模型生成向量，服务端不做推理
options_en: Async: persist and return first, then embed and index in a background job.
Sync: call the model inside the upload request and only return once the index is written.
Embed documents at query time so the write path carries no cost at all.
Have the client run the model locally so the server does no inference.
why: 向量搜索通常允许几秒到几分钟的 stale，把 GPU 推理移出请求路径就能保住上传接口延迟；代价是新文档有一段搜不到的窗口，还要处理 embed 失败重试。
why_en: Vector search results are usually fine being slightly stale, so moving GPU inference off the request path keeps uploads fast — the cost is a window where new documents are not yet searchable, plus retry handling for failed embed jobs.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品要求写入后立刻可搜（比如用户发完就要能搜到自己的内容），同步 embed 换取零 staleness 更合理。
whenOtherWins_en: If the product requires an item to be searchable the instant it is written, synchronous embedding buys zero staleness and wins.
tradeoff: 写路径延迟 vs 索引新鲜度

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据映射成定长向量的 ML 模型，对调用方就是一次昂贵的 GPU 函数调用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An embedding model maps data into a fixed-length vector; to the caller it is essentially one expensive GPU function call.

termDefinitions.meaning: 图形处理器：擅长大规模并行运算，是跑 embedding 推理的主要硬件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A GPU, or Graphics Processing Unit, does massively parallel math and is the usual hardware for running embedding inference.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据写入到能被检索到之间的时间差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Staleness is the lag between when data is written and when it becomes searchable.

optionExplanations: 对，向量结果可接受短暂 stale，把推理挪到后台就能保住上传接口延迟。
把 GPU 调用挂在请求里，上传延迟直接被推理耗时绑住。
查询时才 embed 文档就退化成全量重算，读延迟会彻底崩掉。
客户端设备算力与模型版本都不可控，向量空间会不一致。
optionExplanations_en: Right — tolerating brief staleness lets inference move to a background worker and keeps upload latency low.
Putting the GPU call inside the request ties upload latency directly to inference time.
Embedding documents at query time means recomputing everything per query, destroying read latency.
Client hardware and model versions are uncontrolled, so the vector space would drift between users.

scenario: 两篇文档语义几乎一样，但长文的向量 magnitude 明显更大，现在要选相似度度量。
scenario_en: Two documents mean nearly the same thing, but the longer one has a noticeably larger vector magnitude, and you must pick a similarity metric.
q: 该用 Euclidean（L2）距离还是 cosine similarity？
q_en: Should you use Euclidean (L2) distance or cosine similarity here?
options: cosine similarity：只看夹角，忽略 magnitude 差异
Euclidean（L2）：直线距离同时受方向和 magnitude 影响
Hamming distance：直接 XOR 两个向量的 bit 后计数
两者结果必然一致，向量归没归一化都无所谓
options_en: Cosine similarity — it measures the angle and ignores magnitude.
Euclidean (L2) — straight-line distance, affected by both direction and magnitude.
Hamming distance — XOR the bits of the two vectors and count the differences.
They always agree, so it makes no difference whether vectors are normalized.
why: 这里在意语义方向而不是向量长度，L2 会因为 magnitude 差距把方向相同的两个向量判得很远；代价是 cosine 丢掉幅度信息，幅度本身有意义时就不能用。
why_en: We care about semantic direction, not length — L2 would push two same-direction vectors apart just because their magnitudes differ, while the cost of cosine is that it discards magnitude entirely.
whenOtherWins: 当向量幅度本身有含义（真实坐标、计数特征、量纲一致的物理量）时，L2 才是对的度量。
whenOtherWins_en: When magnitude itself carries meaning — real coordinates or count features — L2 is the right metric.
tradeoff: cosine 忽略 magnitude vs L2 同时受方向与幅度影响

termDefinitions.meaning: 向量的长度，即各维平方和开根号，与向量指向哪个方向无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Magnitude is the length of a vector, the square root of the sum of its squared components, independent of the direction it points.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两点间的直线距离，是勾股定理推广到高维，同时受方向和模长影响。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Euclidean distance, also called L2, is the straight-line distance between two points, the Pythagorean theorem extended to many dimensions, and it reacts to both direction and magnitude.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个向量夹角的余弦值，1 表示同向、0 垂直、-1 反向，与模长无关。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cosine similarity is the cosine of the angle between two vectors — 1 means same direction, 0 perpendicular, -1 opposite — and it ignores magnitude.

termDefinitions.meaning: 未归一化的余弦相似度，等于余弦值乘两个向量的模长，算起来略快。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The dot product is cosine similarity without normalization — cosine multiplied by both vector lengths — and is slightly cheaper to compute.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个二进制向量取值不同的位数，XOR 后数 1 即可，非常快。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Hamming distance counts the positions where two binary vectors differ, computed by XOR-ing and counting bits, which is extremely fast.

termDefinitions.meaning: 局部敏感哈希：故意让相似向量落进同一个桶的哈希索引方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LSH, or Locality Sensitive Hashing, deliberately designs hash functions so that similar vectors collide into the same bucket.

optionExplanations: 对，只比方向能让长短不同但语义一致的两个文档仍然靠得很近。
L2 会把幅度差当成语义差，正是这里要避免的偏差。
Hamming 只能用在二进制向量上，浮点向量用不了。
只有向量都归一化后两者排序才等价，这里恰恰没归一化。
optionExplanations_en: Right — comparing direction only keeps two same-meaning documents close despite different lengths.
L2 treats the magnitude gap as a semantic gap, exactly the bias to avoid here.
Hamming only applies to binary vectors and cannot be used on float vectors.
The two only rank identically once vectors are normalized, which is not the case here.

scenario: 内部法务检索工具只有几十万条向量，要求 100% recall，团队不想承担近似索引的误差和维护成本。
scenario_en: An internal legal search tool holds only a few hundred thousand vectors, demands 100% recall, and the team wants to avoid the approximation error and upkeep of an approximate index.
q: 怎样让 exact KNN 在这个规模上仍然跑得动？
q_en: How do you keep exact KNN viable at this scale?
options: 用 SIMD 或 GPU 向量化，一次算多条向量的相似度
把向量维度砍到 8 维，让全量线性扫描变得便宜很多
必须改用 HNSW 图索引，暴力扫描在任何规模都不可行
只扫描最近写入的那一小部分向量，其余的全部忽略
options_en: Use SIMD or GPU vectorization to score many vectors per instruction.
Cut the vector down to 8 dimensions so a full linear scan gets much cheaper.
Switch to an HNSW graph index — brute-force scanning is never viable at any scale.
Only scan the small slice of most recently written vectors and ignore the rest.
why: 规模不大又要 100% recall 时，只需把 O(n) 扫描的常数压下来：SIMD 一条指令算 2-8 条，GPU 一次算上千条；代价是算力仍随向量数线性增长。
why_en: When the corpus is small and recall must be perfect, you only need to shrink the constant on the O(n) scan — SIMD scores two to eight vectors per instruction and a GPU thousands at once — but compute still grows linearly with the vector count.
whenOtherWins: 向量数涨到百万乃至上亿级时，线性扫描的算力成本再多 SIMD 也摊不平，这时近似索引更划算。
whenOtherWins_en: Once you reach millions or hundreds of millions of vectors, no amount of SIMD pays for a linear scan and an approximate index wins.
tradeoff: 精确 recall + 线性算力 vs 近似索引 + 维护成本

termDefinitions.meaning: 单指令多数据：CPU 用一条指令同时对 2-8 组数据做同样运算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: SIMD, or Single Instruction Multiple Data, lets a CPU apply one instruction to two to eight pieces of data at the same time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把查询向量和全部向量逐一比较后排序取前 K，recall 恒为 100%。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Exact KNN compares the query against every stored vector and returns the true top K, so recall is always 100%.

termDefinitions.meaning: 图形处理器：一次可对上千条向量做同样的相似度运算。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A GPU, or Graphics Processing Unit, can run the same similarity computation across thousands of vectors at once.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层可导航小世界图：生产环境最常用的近似最近邻图索引。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW, or Hierarchical Navigable Small World, is the most common graph-based approximate nearest neighbor index in production.

optionExplanations: 对，硬件向量化把每条比较的成本压低，几十万条全量扫描就能进延迟预算。
砍到 8 维会大幅丢失语义信息，省了算力却毁掉检索质量。
说反了：本题恰恰是暴力扫描仍可行、且能保住 100% recall 的规模。
只扫最近写入的向量会漏掉老文档，直接违背精确检索的要求。
optionExplanations_en: Right — hardware vectorization cuts the per-comparison cost enough that a few hundred thousand vectors fit the latency budget.
Dropping to 8 dimensions throws away semantic nuance, saving compute but wrecking result quality.
This reverses the point: this is exactly the scale where brute force still works and keeps perfect recall.
Scanning only recent vectors misses older documents, breaking the exact-search requirement outright.

scenario: IVF 索引把 nprobe 从 10 调到 40 以提升 recall；压测单查询延迟几乎没变，上线后线上平均延迟却明显上升。
scenario_en: An IVF index raises nprobe from 10 to 40 to improve recall; single-query latency in the lab barely moves, yet average latency in production clearly goes up.
q: 为什么线下不涨、线上平均延迟却上升？
q_en: Why is latency flat in the lab but higher in production?
options: 线上请求已把 CPU 占满，多探测的算力抢不到并行余量
nprobe 只在线上生效，压测环境根本没走到这个参数
更多探测会让 cluster 的 centroid 漂移，索引结构被破坏
线上向量数量更多，nprobe 会被系统自动放大成更大的值
options_en: Production already saturates the CPU, so the extra probes find no spare parallelism to hide behind.
nprobe only takes effect in production; the load test never exercised that parameter.
More probes shift the cluster centroids and corrupt the index structure.
Production holds more vectors, so the system automatically scales nprobe up.
why: 单查询时多个 probe 可以并行，延迟被并行度吸收；但满载系统里核心已被其他请求占满，多出的探测只能排队，直接变成平均延迟上升。
why_en: Probes parallelize well for a single query, so extra probes hide behind spare cores — but in a saturated system every core is already busy, so more probes just queue and show up as higher average latency.
tradeoff: 更高 recall vs 满载时被吃掉的平均延迟

termDefinitions.meaning: 倒排文件索引：用 k-means 把向量分成若干 cluster，查询只搜最近的几个。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF, or Inverted File Index, uses k-means to split vectors into clusters and only searches the clusters nearest the query.

termDefinitions.meaning: IVF 查询时探测多少个 cluster 的参数，调大提升 recall、增加算力消耗。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: nprobe controls how many clusters an IVF query probes — raising it improves recall but costs more compute.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个 cluster 的中心点，向量按离哪个质心最近来归属。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A centroid is the center point of a cluster, and each vector is assigned to whichever centroid is nearest.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似检索返回结果中覆盖真实最近邻的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall is the fraction of the true nearest neighbors that an approximate search actually returns.

optionExplanations: 对，空闲机器上探测可并行，满载时它变成实打实的额外 CPU 消耗。
nprobe 是查询参数，压测同样会走到，环境差别不在这里。
质心是建索引时算好的，查询探测多少个不会改动它们。
nprobe 是人为设定值，不会随数据量被系统自动放大。
optionExplanations_en: Right — probes overlap on an idle box, but under saturation they turn into real extra CPU work.
nprobe is a query parameter that the load test exercises too; the difference is not there.
Centroids are computed at build time and probing more of them does not move them.
nprobe is a value you set, not something the system scales with data volume.

scenario: 用一张由 8 个随机超平面构成的 LSH 表做近邻召回，线上发现明显相似的向量经常召不回来。
scenario_en: A single LSH table built from 8 random hyperplanes is used for retrieval, and obviously similar vectors keep failing to come back.
q: 单张 LSH 表为什么会漏掉相似向量，怎么修？
q_en: Why does a single LSH table miss similar vectors, and how do you fix it?
options: 相似向量可能被某个超平面切到两侧，多张表提升共桶概率
hash 冲突太多了，应该换成尽量避免冲突的普通 hash 函数
8 bit 产生的桶太多导致内存爆掉，应该减少到 1 bit
超平面必须人工挑选，随机超平面本身不能用于召回
options_en: Two similar vectors can land on opposite sides of one hyperplane; more tables raise the odds they share a bucket.
There are too many hash collisions, so switch to an ordinary collision-avoiding hash function.
8 bits creates too many buckets and blows up memory, so drop down to 1 bit.
Hyperplanes must be hand-picked; random hyperplanes cannot be used for retrieval.
why: LSH 靠“相似即同桶”的概率工作，单表里一次不利的切分就能把邻居分开；多张不同超平面的表把“至少共享一个桶”的概率抬上去，代价是内存与查询成本成倍增长。
why_en: LSH works on the probability that similar items collide, so one unlucky split in a single table separates true neighbors — extra tables with different hyperplanes raise the chance of sharing at least one bucket, at multiplied memory and query cost.
tradeoff: 单表省内存 vs 多表提升 recall

termDefinitions.meaning: 局部敏感哈希：故意设计成让相似向量碰撞到同一个桶的哈希方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LSH, or Locality Sensitive Hashing, uses hash functions deliberately designed to make similar vectors collide into the same bucket.

termDefinitions.meaning: 高维空间里的一个“平面”，把空间切成两半，向量落在哪边就是一个 hash bit。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hyperplane is a plane in high-dimensional space that cuts it in two; which side a vector falls on becomes one hash bit.

termDefinitions.meaning: 同一个 hash 值对应的一组向量，查询时先取桶再精算距离。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash bucket holds all vectors sharing one hash value; a query pulls buckets first and computes real distances afterwards.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似检索返回结果中覆盖真实最近邻的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall is the fraction of true nearest neighbors that an approximate search returns.

optionExplanations: 对，一次不利切分就足以让邻居分桶，多表让它们至少在一张表里同桶。
方向反了：LSH 要的正是相似项碰撞，避免冲突的 hash 完全不能用。
少到 1 bit 只会把半个库塞进一个桶，候选集爆炸而不是变准。
随机超平面正是标准做法，人工挑选既不可行也不必要。
optionExplanations_en: Right — one bad split separates neighbors, and extra tables give them another chance to collide.
Backwards: LSH wants similar items to collide, so a collision-avoiding hash defeats the purpose.
Dropping to 1 bit puts half the corpus in one bucket, exploding the candidate set instead of sharpening it.
Random hyperplanes are the standard construction; hand-picking them is neither practical nor needed.

scenario: 系统用 4 张随机超平面 LSH 表索引向量，现在来了一个查询向量要找它的近邻。
scenario_en: A system indexes vectors with four random-hyperplane LSH tables, and a query vector arrives looking for neighbors.
q: 把 LSH 的查询流程按顺序排列：
q_en: Put the LSH query flow in order.
steps: 取出所有命中桶里的向量，合并成一个候选集
把 query 向量在每张 hash 表里各算一次 hash 值
只对候选集里的向量精算真实距离，取 top-K
why: LSH 只用桶命中做粗筛，真实距离仍要逐个精算，所以候选集大小直接决定查询成本；表越多召回越全，但合并出的候选集也越大。
why_en: LSH only uses bucket hits as a coarse filter and still computes real distances on the survivors, so candidate-set size drives query cost — more tables mean better recall but a bigger merged candidate set.
tradeoff: 更多表提升 recall vs 候选集变大拖慢精算
diagram:
flowchart LR
    Q["query vector"] --> H["hash in every table"]
    H --> B["collect matching buckets"]
    B --> C["merge candidate set"]
    C --> D["exact distance on candidates"]
    D --> K["top K"]

termDefinitions.meaning: 局部敏感哈希：让相似向量落进同一个桶的哈希索引方法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LSH, or Locality Sensitive Hashing, is an indexing method whose hash functions make similar vectors land in the same bucket.

termDefinitions.meaning: 粗筛阶段挑出来、需要进一步精算真实距离的那批向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A candidate set is the group of vectors surviving the coarse filter, on which exact distances are then computed.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按相似度排序后返回的前 K 个结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Top-K means the K highest-scoring results after ranking by similarity.

scenario: LSH 召回率不够，工程师打算把表数从 4 张加到 16 张，同时把每张表的 hash 从 8 bit 加到 16 bit。
scenario_en: Recall is too low, so an engineer plans to go from 4 LSH tables to 16 and from 8-bit hashes to 16-bit.
q: 更多表、更多 bit 会换来什么代价？
q_en: What does adding more tables and more bits cost?
options: recall 上升，内存占用和查询耗时同时上升
recall 上升，而且桶更小所以查询会同时变快
recall 不变，只是索引构建时间会变长一些
recall 下降，更多超平面会把相似向量打散
options_en: Recall goes up, and both memory footprint and query time go up with it.
Recall goes up and queries get faster too, because the buckets are smaller.
Recall stays the same; only index build time gets longer.
Recall goes down, because more hyperplanes scatter similar vectors.
why: 每加一张表就多存一份完整的桶索引，查询要在所有表上哈希再合并候选；更多 bit 让桶更精细，recall 上去的同时内存和查询开销一起上去。
why_en: Each extra table stores another full bucket index and every query must hash into all of them and merge candidates, while more bits make buckets finer — recall improves and memory plus query cost rise together.
tradeoff: recall vs 内存占用与查询耗时

termDefinitions.meaning: 局部敏感哈希：用随机超平面把相似向量哈希到同一个桶。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LSH, or Locality Sensitive Hashing, uses random hyperplanes to hash similar vectors into the same bucket.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个超平面产生的 1 位取值，向量在平面哪一侧决定它是 0 还是 1。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hash bit is the single bit produced by one hyperplane, set by which side of the plane the vector falls on.

termDefinitions.meaning: 近似检索返回结果中覆盖真实最近邻的比例。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recall is the fraction of true nearest neighbors that an approximate search returns.

optionExplanations: 对，多表多 bit 把 recall 买上来，账单是内存和每次查询的哈希与合并成本。
查询要在 16 张表上都哈希并合并候选，总耗时是上升而不是下降。
表数和 bit 数是 recall 的主要调节旋钮，说它不变等于否认这个机制。
方向反了：多表的作用正是提高相似向量至少共享一个桶的概率。
optionExplanations_en: Right — more tables and bits buy recall, and the bill is memory plus per-query hashing and merging.
A query must hash into all 16 tables and merge candidates, so total time rises rather than falls.
Table count and bit count are the main recall knobs, so claiming recall is unchanged denies the mechanism.
Backwards — more tables exist precisely to raise the chance similar vectors share at least one bucket.

scenario: IVF 索引上线半年，新数据分布和当初 k-means 算出的 centroid 已经对不上，同样 nprobe 下 recall 持续下滑。
scenario_en: An IVF index has run for six months; the new data distribution no longer matches the centroids from the original k-means run, and recall keeps sliding at the same nprobe.
q: 该怎么处理这种 cluster 漂移？
q_en: How should you handle this cluster drift?
options: 周期性重新聚类并重建索引，新旧并存后再切换
把 nprobe 一路调大，靠扫更多 cluster 补回 recall
给每个新向量单独建一个 cluster，避免被归错桶
用 soft delete 清掉旧向量，centroid 会自动回正
options_en: Periodically re-cluster and rebuild the index, running old and new side by side before switching.
Keep raising nprobe and win recall back by scanning more clusters.
Give each new vector its own cluster so nothing gets assigned to the wrong bucket.
Soft-delete the old vectors and let the centroids correct themselves.
why: 漂移后新向量离原 centroid 越来越远、被分进错的 cluster，同样 nprobe 就搜不到它们；只能重新聚类并重建，代价是重建期要靠旧索引继续服务再整体切换。
why_en: After drift, new vectors sit far from the original centroids and land in the wrong clusters, so the same nprobe stops reaching them — the only real fix is re-clustering and rebuilding, paying for it with a window where the stale index keeps serving until you swap.
tradeoff: 调大 nprobe 临时补救 vs 重新聚类根治

termDefinitions.meaning: 倒排文件索引：用 k-means 把向量划成 cluster，查询只搜最近的几个。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF, or Inverted File Index, partitions vectors into clusters with k-means and searches only the clusters nearest the query.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把点分成 k 组、每组用一个质心代表的聚类算法，IVF 用它划分向量空间。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: k-means is a clustering algorithm that splits points into k groups each represented by a centroid, which IVF uses to partition the vector space.

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据分布随时间变化，使建索引时算出的质心不再代表当前向量分布。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cluster drift is when the data distribution shifts over time so the centroids computed at build time no longer represent the current vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只把条目标记为已删除而不真正从索引移除，空间和查询成本仍在。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A soft delete only marks an entry as removed instead of taking it out of the index, so it still costs space and query time.

termDefinitions.meaning: IVF 查询探测多少个 cluster 的参数。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: nprobe is the parameter controlling how many clusters an IVF query probes.

optionExplanations: 对，只有重算质心才能让分区重新贴合数据，并存切换保证期间可用。
这是止痛药：每查一次都多花算力，分区本身错位的问题没解决。
cluster 数逼近向量数就退化成全量扫描，索引的跳过能力归零。
软删除只是打标记，既不移除数据也不会重算质心。
optionExplanations_en: Right — only recomputing centroids realigns the partitions with the data, and a side-by-side swap keeps it available.
That is a painkiller: every query burns more compute while the misaligned partitions stay misaligned.
As cluster count approaches vector count the index degenerates into a full scan and skips nothing.
A soft delete just sets a flag; it neither removes data nor recomputes centroids.

scenario: 新写入的向量要等下一次合并才进 HNSW 冷索引，但产品要求刚上传的内容立刻能被搜到。
scenario_en: Newly written vectors only enter the cold HNSW index at the next merge, yet the product wants freshly uploaded content searchable immediately.
q: hot 索引该做成什么形态？
q_en: What form should the hot index take?
options: 一个尚未建索引的条目列表，查询时直接暴力扫
再建一个完整的 HNSW 图，结构和冷索引保持一致
把新向量直接插进冷索引，完全不要 hot 这一层
用缓存存住最近的查询结果，绕开索引新鲜度问题
options_en: Just a list of not-yet-indexed entries that queries scan exhaustively.
A second full HNSW graph mirroring the structure of the cold index.
Insert new vectors straight into the cold index and skip the hot layer entirely.
Cache recent query results and sidestep the freshness problem.
why: hot 集合本来就小，线性扫的成本可以忽略，不值得为它承担 HNSW 的构建和内存开销；代价是 hot 越积越大延迟会涨，必须周期性并入冷索引。
why_en: The hot set is small enough that scanning it linearly is cheap, so it does not deserve HNSW build and memory overhead — the cost is that its scan time grows until you fold it into the cold index.
whenOtherWins: 如果 hot 集合能积到几十万条（写入洪峰或合并任务停摆），暴力扫就撑不住，hot 也得建成真索引。
whenOtherWins_en: If the hot set can grow to hundreds of thousands of entries during a write spike or a stalled merge, brute force stops working and the hot layer needs a real index.
tradeoff: 暴力扫 hot 的零构建成本 vs 给 hot 也建索引

termDefinitions.term: hot / cold index / 冷热索引
termDefinitions.meaning: 小的 hot 结构装最近写入、大的 cold 索引装历史数据，查询扫两边再合并结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hot index holds recent writes while a large cold index holds historical data, and queries search both and merge results.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层可导航小世界图：构建慢、内存约为原始向量两倍的图式近似索引。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW, or Hierarchical Navigable Small World, is a graph index that is slow to build and roughly doubles the memory of the raw vectors.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对集合里每个向量都算一次相似度，不走任何索引跳过。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A brute-force scan computes similarity against every vector in the set without any index-based skipping.

optionExplanations: 对，几千条向量线性扫的耗时可以忽略，省下整套图构建成本。
给一个小而且很快会被并走的集合建图，构建开销远大于收益。
HNSW 逐条插入贵且会让图结构随时间退化，正是要用 hot 层挡掉的。
缓存旧结果不会让新写入的向量出现在结果里，问题原封不动。
optionExplanations_en: Right — scanning a few thousand vectors linearly is negligible and skips the whole graph build.
Building a graph for a small set that will soon be merged away costs far more than it returns.
Per-vector HNSW inserts are expensive and degrade the graph over time — exactly what the hot layer absorbs.
Caching old results never surfaces newly written vectors, so the freshness gap remains.

scenario: 上游 ML 模型每天刷新一次，导致几千万条 embedding 大面积变动，检索侧用的是 HNSW 索引。
scenario_en: An upstream ML model refreshes daily, changing tens of millions of embeddings at once, and retrieval runs on an HNSW index.
q: 更新策略该选逐条实时写还是批量加周期重建？
q_en: Should updates go through real-time upserts or batch plus periodic rebuild?
options: 批量更新加周期性重建，建好新索引再整体切换
逐条实时 upsert，保证索引任何时刻都是最新的
只做 soft delete，既不重建索引也不写入新向量
改用 IVF 索引，这样就完全不需要任何重建策略
options_en: Batch the updates and rebuild periodically, swapping in the new index once it is ready.
Upsert one vector at a time so the index is always current.
Only soft-delete, rebuilding nothing and writing no new vectors.
Switch to IVF so no rebuild strategy is needed at all.
why: HNSW 每条插入都要重新找位置、建连接，图还会随插入退化，几千万条逐条写代价极高；批量重建的代价是数据到可搜索之间隔着一整个批次的 staleness。
why_en: Every HNSW insert has to locate the vector and rewire its connections, and the graph degrades as inserts pile up, so writing tens of millions one by one is brutally expensive — the price of batching is a full cycle of staleness before data becomes searchable.
whenOtherWins: 如果每次变动量很小且业务要求秒级可搜（如新发布内容必须马上能被检索），实时 upsert 配 hot 索引更合适。
whenOtherWins_en: If each change set is small and content must be searchable within seconds of publishing, real-time upserts backed by a hot index fit better.
tradeoff: 索引新鲜度 vs 索引构建与图退化成本

termDefinitions.meaning: 存在则更新、不存在则插入的写操作；向量库里通常实现为删除加插入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An upsert updates a record if it exists and inserts it otherwise; in vector databases it is usually implemented as a delete plus an insert.

termDefinitions.meaning: 分层可导航小世界图：插入代价高，图结构会随大量插入退化。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: HNSW, or Hierarchical Navigable Small World, has expensive inserts and its graph quality degrades as many vectors are added after the initial build.

termDefinitions.meaning: 倒排文件索引：插入便宜，但 cluster 会随时间漂移，同样需要重新聚类。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: IVF, or Inverted File Index, handles inserts cheaply but its clusters drift over time and still need periodic re-clustering.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在旧索引旁边建一份新索引，建好后切换，避免查询中断。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A rolling rebuild builds a new index alongside the old one and swaps once it is ready so queries are never interrupted.

termDefinitions.meaning: 只把向量标记为已删除，不真正从索引移除。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A soft delete only marks a vector as removed rather than physically taking it out of the index.

optionExplanations: 对，大面积变动一次性重建的总成本远低于逐条改图，切换也能整体完成。
每条都要重连图边，几千万条会把写入算力和查询延迟一起吃掉。
只标删不写新向量，检索结果会永远停在旧模型的语义上。
IVF 插入确实更便宜，但 cluster 漂移同样逼着你周期性重新聚类。
optionExplanations_en: Right — one rebuild costs far less in total than rewiring the graph tens of millions of times, and the swap happens at once.
Each insert rewires graph edges, so tens of millions of them eat both write throughput and query latency.
Marking deletions without writing new vectors freezes results at the old model's semantics forever.
IVF does take inserts more cheaply, but cluster drift still forces periodic re-clustering.

scenario: 文档原件已经全部存在 S3，向量量级不大、查询也不频繁，团队不想再多运维一套系统。
scenario_en: The source documents already live in S3, the vector count is modest, queries are infrequent, and the team does not want another system to operate.
q: S3 Vectors 在这个架构里的定位是什么？
q_en: What role does S3 Vectors play in this architecture?
options: 向量存 S3、用 S3 API 查询，省掉一套新系统
把 S3 当作 Pinecone 前面的本地缓存层来加速查询
S3 只能存原始文件，向量必须另外放进专用向量库
它是 pgvector 的托管版本，自带 SQL join 与事务
options_en: Store vectors in S3 and query them through the S3 API, avoiding a new system entirely.
Use S3 as a local cache layer in front of Pinecone to speed queries up.
S3 can only hold raw files, so vectors must live in a dedicated vector database.
It is a managed pgvector that brings SQL joins and transactions along.
why: 已经重度用 S3 且不愿引入专用向量系统时，S3 Vectors 让向量检索直接复用现有存储；代价是索引与查询能力比专用向量库简单得多。
why_en: When you already lean on S3 heavily and do not want a dedicated vector system, S3 Vectors reuses the storage you have — at the cost of much simpler indexing and query capability than a purpose-built vector database.
whenOtherWins: 当规模超过约 100M 向量，或需要复杂的带过滤近似检索与低延迟在线查询时，Pinecone/Milvus 这类专用系统才划算。
whenOtherWins_en: Past roughly 100M vectors, or when you need complex filtered approximate search and low-latency online queries, a purpose-built system like Pinecone or Milvus earns its keep.
tradeoff: 复用已有 S3 的零新增运维 vs 专用向量库的索引能力

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的较新能力：把向量存进 S3 并用 S3 API 查询，免去引入专用向量库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3 Vectors is a newer AWS offering that stores vectors in S3 and queries them through the S3 API, avoiding a dedicated vector database.

termDefinitions.meaning: AWS 的对象存储服务，按 key 存取任意大小的对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3, or Simple Storage Service, is AWS's object store that keeps arbitrary objects addressed by key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 全托管、无服务器的专用向量数据库，只用 API 调用，代价是成本与可控性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pinecone is a fully managed, serverless vector database you access purely through an API, trading cost and control for ease of operation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 给 PostgreSQL 加向量类型与近似索引的扩展，可与 SQL 和事务一起用。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pgvector is a Postgres extension adding a vector type and approximate indexes so vector search runs inside normal SQL.

termDefinitions.meaning: 开源专用向量数据库，能撑到十亿级向量，代价是分布式运维复杂度。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Milvus is an open-source vector database built for billions of vectors, at the cost of operating a distributed system.

optionExplanations: 对，向量和文档同住 S3，检索走 S3 API，架构里不新增待运维组件。
它是独立的检索能力，不是挂在别的向量库前面的缓存。
这正是 S3 Vectors 要打破的前提：S3 现在能直接被向量查询。
SQL join 与事务是 pgvector 的卖点，不是 S3 Vectors 提供的能力。
optionExplanations_en: Right — vectors sit beside the documents in S3 and are queried via the S3 API, adding no new component to operate.
It is a standalone retrieval capability, not a cache sitting in front of another vector store.
That is exactly the assumption S3 Vectors breaks: S3 can now answer vector queries directly.
SQL joins and transactions are pgvector's pitch, not what S3 Vectors provides.

scenario: 工单系统要自动合并重复工单，用户描述同一个问题时措辞完全不同，正文 hash 一条都撞不上。
scenario_en: A ticketing system wants to auto-merge duplicate tickets, but users describe the same problem in totally different wording, so body hashes never collide.
q: 该用什么检索方式判定“近重复”？
q_en: What retrieval approach should decide near-duplicates here?
options: 把工单 embed 后做向量检索，取相似度超过阈值的
对工单正文做 MD5，只有 hash 完全相同才算重复
用 BM25 关键词检索，共同关键词多就判定为重复
让 LLM 把新工单和全部历史工单逐对比较后判定
options_en: Embed the tickets and run vector search, keeping matches above a similarity threshold.
MD5 the ticket body and call it a duplicate only on an exact hash match.
Use BM25 keyword search and flag duplicates when enough keywords overlap.
Have an LLM compare the new ticket against every historical ticket pairwise.
why: 措辞不同但语义相同时精确 hash 一条都命中不到，而向量间的几何距离恰好表达语义接近；代价是相似度阈值要靠真实数据调，太松会误合并不同问题。
why_en: Exact hashing matches nothing when wording differs but meaning does not, whereas geometric distance between embeddings captures exactly that closeness — the cost is a similarity threshold you must tune on real data.
whenOtherWins: 如果重复的定义就是逐字节一致（转载原文、同一个图片文件），精确 hash 更便宜也更准。
whenOtherWins_en: If a duplicate means byte-identical content, like a re-uploaded image file, exact hashing is both cheaper and more precise.
tradeoff: 精确 hash 的确定性 vs 语义阈值的召回能力

termDefinitions.meaning: 找出内容不完全相同但语义高度重合的条目，如抄袭、重复工单、重复商品列表。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Near-duplicate detection finds items that are not byte-identical but highly overlapping in meaning, such as plagiarism, repeated support tickets, or duplicate listings.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把任意输入映射成定长摘要的哈希算法，输入差一个字节摘要就完全不同。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: MD5, or Message Digest 5, hashes any input into a fixed-length digest that changes completely if a single byte differs.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关键词全文检索的经典打分算法，按词频和文档长度排序。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: BM25, short for Best Matching 25, is a classic keyword ranking algorithm scoring by term frequency and document length.

termDefinitions.meaning: 大语言模型：能理解与生成自然语言，但逐对调用成本高、延迟大。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An LLM, or Large Language Model, understands and generates natural language but is expensive and slow to call for every pair.

termDefinitions.meaning: 判定两个向量算不算重复的分数界线，需要用真实数据标定。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A similarity threshold is the score cutoff at which two vectors count as duplicates, and it has to be calibrated on real data.

optionExplanations: 对，语义距离能抓住措辞不同但问题相同的工单，阈值控制判重松紧。
换个词整段摘要就变，正是本题里精确哈希完全失效的原因。
关键词重合会漏掉同义表述，也会误伤只是共用高频词的工单。
逐对调用在历史工单量级上成本和延迟都不可行，得先做向量召回。
optionExplanations_en: Right — semantic distance catches tickets that describe the same issue in different words, with the threshold controlling strictness.
Changing one word changes the whole digest, which is precisely why hashing fails here.
Keyword overlap misses paraphrases and false-flags tickets that merely share common words.
Pairwise calls across the full ticket history are infeasible in cost and latency; vector retrieval must narrow candidates first.

scenario: 推荐服务峰值约 200,000 QPS 走向量召回，索引可以整份放进内存，现在要估算需要多少台检索节点。
scenario_en: A recommendation service peaks around 200,000 QPS of vector retrieval, the index fits entirely in memory, and you need to size the retrieval fleet.
q: 该用什么吞吐量锚点来估算节点数？
q_en: What throughput anchor should size the node count?
options: 每节点每秒数万次查询，200k QPS 大致十来台起步
每节点每秒数百次查询，200k QPS 需要上千台机器
每节点每秒数百万次查询，单节点就能扛下全部流量
吞吐只由向量维度决定，和节点数量之间没有关系
options_en: Tens of thousands of queries per second per node, so 200k QPS starts around a dozen nodes.
A few hundred queries per second per node, so 200k QPS needs a thousand-plus machines.
Millions of queries per second per node, so a single node absorbs all the traffic.
Throughput depends only on vector dimension and has nothing to do with node count.
why: 节点数 = 峰值 QPS ÷ 单节点吞吐；QPS = Queries Per Second（每秒查询数），内存索引单节点数万 QPS 是经验锚点，200k ÷ 2万 ≈ 10 台，再乘副本数，就是后续算总内存与分片数的基数。
why_en: Node count equals peak QPS divided by per-node throughput; QPS means queries per second, and tens of thousands per node is the rule-of-thumb anchor for an in-memory index, so 200k over 20k is about ten nodes before replication — and that number feeds your memory and shard math.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每秒查询数：系统每秒处理的查询请求量，是容量估算的输入。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: QPS, or Queries Per Second, is how many query requests a system handles each second and is the input to capacity estimation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 整份索引驻留内存，避免磁盘 I/O，因此单节点吞吐能到每秒数万次查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An in-memory index keeps the whole structure in RAM, avoiding disk I/O, which is why a single node can reach tens of thousands of queries per second.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把索引按数据切成若干份分散到不同节点，各自只保存和搜索一部分向量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A shard is a slice of the index placed on its own node, holding and searching only part of the vectors.

optionExplanations: 对，这是纯内存检索的经验吞吐锚点，拿峰值除以它就得到起步机器数。
数百 QPS 是磁盘型或未调优系统的量级，低估了内存索引一个数量级。
百万级 QPS 超出单节点能力，会把容量估算算成只需一台机器。
维度影响单次比较成本，但节点数由总吞吐需求决定，两者不是无关。
optionExplanations_en: Right — this is the empirical per-node anchor for pure in-memory retrieval, and dividing peak load by it gives the starting fleet size.
A few hundred QPS is disk-bound or untuned territory, underestimating an in-memory index by an order of magnitude.
Millions of QPS per node is beyond a single machine and would size the fleet at one box.
Dimension affects per-comparison cost, but node count follows total throughput demand — the two are linked.
